objective_success_bonus.condition: Both legs contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1) and |x|<0.15 and |y|<0.15 and |vy|<0.5

controlled_descent_bonus.condition: first time distance < 0.3 and m_power > 0 and |angle| < 0.2

touchdown_stability_bonus.condition: first time both legs contact and distance < 0.3 and |vy| < 0.5 and |vx| < 0.5 and |angle| < 0.2
